name: dastaan-committee
description: Dastaan others app (web and api) with the shared code it needs. Part of the Dastaan internal platform, which has three apps on one database.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply dastaan --config wrangler.json --local --persist-to .data
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute dastaan --config wrangler.json --local --persist-to .data --file database/seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:sample: wrangler d1 execute dastaan --config wrangler.json --local --persist-to .data --file database/seed/dev-users.sql
scripts.db:clean: wrangler d1 execute dastaan --config wrangler.json --local --persist-to .data --file database/seed/clean.sql
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply dastaan --config wrangler.json --remote
scripts.db:seed:prod: wrangler d1 execute dastaan --config wrangler.json --remote --file database/seed/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy -w @dastaan/others-api && npm run cf:deploy -w @dastaan/others-web
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute dastaan --config wrangler.json --local --persist-to .data --file database/seed/reset.sql && npm run db:seed && npm run db:sample
